name: TeX Live (from tlnet)
description: Installs the current TeX Live release from CTAN's tlnet repository (not the distro package, which is usually a year or more behind) plus the packages this book needs. Any .sty listed in `styFiles` that is still missing afterwards is resolved to its TeX Live package with `tlmgr search --global --file` and installed, so the container is self-healing as the sources grow.

scheme.description: TeX Live scheme to install as the base. `packages`/`styFiles` are installed on top of it.

packages.description: Comma-separated TeX Live package names to install with tlmgr. Unknown names are reported and skipped rather than failing the build.

styFiles.description: Comma-separated .sty files that must exist after installation. Missing ones are looked up with `tlmgr search --global --file` and their packages installed.
